speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. To start, how many weeks postpartum are you, and what is your current temperature?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: What is the duration and pattern of your fever, and have you noticed any foul-smelling lochia or vaginal discharge? Also, have you experienced any pain with urination or noticed any changes in your bowel movements besides decreased sounds?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Urinary Retention.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential.
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound to assess for uterine retained products of conception.
